resolved.Name: S2
resolved.Title: slow sink (500ms, timeout 2s)
resolved.Description: soar answers every request after 500 ms (below the 2 s client timeout) from 30s to 150s. Only soar's own queue should back up (L1 rises, then returns to 0); healthy sinks keep their latency.

notes: kill = SIGKILL; graceful stop = SIGTERM. kill -9 is not power loss (page cache survives).
